profile.summary: A nonprofit based in Sebastopol, California, that provides treatment and family-focused care to youth and families in Sonoma County and beyond. Its services include foster care and adoption support, young adult housing programs, and Journey Academy, a residential school program for high school students with individualized education programs (IEPs).
